chunks: A group informed me, from Al-Tal'kabari, from Ahmad ibn Ali Al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Uthman ibn Ahmad Al-Sammak, from Ibrahim ibn Abdullah Al-Hashmi, from Yahya ibn Abi Talib, from Ali ibn Asim, from Ataa ibn Saib, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Umar, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The Hour will not arise until about sixty liars emerge, all of them declaring: I am a prophet."
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of false prophets appearing before the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* identifies the proliferation of false prophets as a critical eschatological sign preceding the reappearance of Imam Mahdi (a.s.). The specific mention of 'sixty' figures highlights a period of intense spiritual confusion and doctrinal fragmentation, serving as a precursor to the final emergence of the True Guide. This event underscores the Shia belief in the necessity of the Mahdi to restore authentic divine guidance amidst widespread deception.
